title: VIC-20 flash timing and expansion write-back regression suite
condition: `Flash040EraseLatencyTests` verifies the VICE TYPE_B sector timeout, sector/chip cycle budgets, busy status, cancel, suspend, and resume behavior. `Vic20ExpansionCartTests`, `UltimemParityTests`, `MegaCartParityTests`, and `MediaServiceHostVic20ExpansionTests` verify mapping, dirty-state separation, and atomic detach persistence.
